summary.en: A guided tour of one page: the camera flies to four of its parts; at each the cursor arrives first, clicks, and the page answers; then the camera pulls back on all four answers.
summary.zh: 一页的导览：相机飞到页面的四处，每处光标先到、点击，页面给出回应；最后拉远，四处回应同框。

fits: A product page whose four features each answer one click (demo).
notFor: Flows across several pages; features that need typing; more than four stops (each stop is under two seconds).

intent.en: One continuous camera walks the viewer through four features of one page; the cursor is their pointing finger, and each click gets an answer, so cause and place are both remembered.
intent.zh: 一个连续镜头带观众走完一页上的四个功能，光标是导游的手指，每点一下页面就回应，既记住因果也记住位置。

content.en: One product page with four panels, each with a title (≤ 16 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters) and a one-click answer (a range switch, a tooltip, toggles, a table row); product name and nav.
content.zh: 一页产品界面上的四块面板，每块一个标题（≤ 16 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）和点一下就有的回应（切换区间、悬停提示、开关、表格行）；外加产品名和导航。

fits.zh: 一个产品页面上的四个功能，各自点一下就有回应。

notFor.zh: 跨多页的流程；需要打字的功能；多于四站（每站不到两秒）。

en: With real screenshots, mark each stop on the control's centre and use at least 1.3× native resolution.
Keep the camera's arrival and the cursor's click paired: a click while the camera still moves gets lost in the blur.
zh: 用真实截图时，每站落点要标到控件中心，截图分辨率至少 1.3 倍。
相机到位和光标点击成对调；相机还在动时点击，回应会被运动模糊吃掉。

upstream.name: 四角巡览指点
upstream.summary: 整页俯瞰后，相机依次飞到四个功能区 zoom-in 特写，SVG 光标先一步到位指点、点击留下涟漪并触发界面响应，最后拉回俯瞰
upstream.use: 单页产品的功能巡览：一镜带观众看完四个功能区，光标当"导游手指"
upstream.energy: 中（等距巡航，节奏靠点击涟漪打点）

overlaps.note: viewport-push is one push into a part of a page; cursor-tour strings four of them with a cursor that leads and a page that answers
cursor-crowd shows many cursors at once; cursor-tour follows one through a page
